name: resilireplay
description: Turn supported coding-agent tool failures into sanitized, deterministic regression evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Capture tool failures as regression evidence.
interface.longDescription: Passive, opt-in coding-agent hooks and a local stdio MCP server turn supported failures into bounded evidence and executable regression tests.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use ResiliReplay to capture this session's tool failures, explain the recovery boundary, and turn the last supported failure into a regression test.
